description: For every function g from naturals to naturals, the function h(n)=g(n)+1 is not eventually dominated by g, so no function eventually dominates all such functions.
signature: Lemmatheca.SetTheory.FiniteErrors.successor_not_eventuallyLE (g : ℕ → ℕ) : ¬(fun n => g n + 1) ≤ᶠ[Filter.atTop] g
